description:
Tempo is a rock-solid metronome for practice, rehearsal and recording. Beats are scheduled on the audio clock itself, so the click never drifts, even at 240 BPM.

Spin the big dial to set any tempo from 30 to 240 BPM, nudge it one beat at a time, or just tap along and let Tempo find the speed for you. Choose 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 or 6/8, then tap any beat light to make it an accent, a normal click or a rest. A swinging pendulum and the Italian tempo marking, from Largo to Presto, keep you oriented at a glance.

Need to tune? Switch to Tuner Tone for a clean reference pitch on any note in seven octaves, with sine or triangle waves, gentle fades, and an adjustable A4 from 415 to 466 Hz for baroque or orchestral tuning.
whatsNew: New Tuner Tone tab with adjustable A4, tappable accent lights for every beat, and a smoother pendulum.
